title: Collection reindex
description: Moves the collection to another embedding model of the model catalogue, which may be on another embedding connection: every document is embedded with the target model through its connection, then the collection switches over in one step and the old model's vectors are deleted. A connection change is only possible together with a model change, because the stored vectors are labelled by the registered model name only.

model.title: Target embedding model
model.description: IRI (/api/refs/provider_models/<uuid>) or full or partial UUID of an available entry of the model catalogue with the capability embedding, on an active ollama connection, whose name is registered in dmstr_neuron_ai.embeddings.models (exactly or without :latest). Its connection becomes the collection's embedding connection; its registered name must differ from the collection's current one.
